# Application, windows and dialogs

The objects every program is built around: the application and its event loop, windows (which are containers of elements), the dialogs, and the framework-wide services - tooltips, the theme, the file loader. They are not elements, but they have options and callbacks of their own.

## Elements

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
| [`UltraCanvasApplicationBase`](../Elements/UltraCanvasApplicationBase.md) | The application: initialisation, the event loop (`Run`), exit, timers, the clipboard and the windows it owns. Construct `UltraCanvasApplication` (the platform's subclass) once in `main`. | `PostToUIThread`, `RegisterEventLoopRunCallback`, `StartTimer`, `AddFdWatch`, `SetThemeProvider`, `onApplicationExitRequest`, `onApplicationExit` |
| [`UltraCanvasDialogManager`](../Elements/UltraCanvasDialogManager.md) | The one-line way to show a message, question, warning, error, confirmation or input dialog; the answer arrives in a callback. | `ShowMessage`, `ShowInformation`, `ShowQuestion`, `ShowWarning`, `ShowError`, `ShowConfirmation`, `ShowInputDialog`, `ShowInputDialog` … |
| [`UltraCanvasFileDialog`](../Elements/UltraCanvasFileDialog.md) | The framework's own open / save / select-folder browser (the native one is used when the setting says so); normally reached through `UltraCanvasFileLoader`. | `onFileSelected`, `onFilesSelected`, `onDirectoryChanged` (+4 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasFileLoader`](../Elements/UltraCanvasFileLoader.md) | Every file a user opens or saves: the dialogs, the readers and writers of every format, conversions, save settings. | `OpenFileDialog`, `OpenMultipleFilesDialog`, `SaveFileDialog`, `SaveFileDialog`, `SelectFolderDialog`, `OpenImage`, `OpenAudio`, `ConvertVideoFile` … |
| [`UltraCanvasInputDialog`](../Elements/UltraCanvasInputDialog.md) | A modal dialog that asks for one value (text, a number, a password). | (+4 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasModalDialog`](../Elements/UltraCanvasModalDialog.md) | A dialog window with a message, an icon, an optional input and a row of buttons; usually shown through `UltraCanvasDialogManager`. | `AddCustomButton`, `AddCustomButton`, `onResult`, `onClosing` |
| [`UltraCanvasTheme`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTheme.md) | The colour roles (light, dark, high contrast or from the host desktop) every element styles itself from. | - |
| [`UltraCanvasTooltipManager`](../Elements/UltraCanvasTooltipManager.md) | The application-wide tooltip: shows and hides an element's tooltip text, with a style of its own. | - |
| [`UltraCanvasWindowBase`](../Elements/UltraCanvasWindowBase.md) | A top-level window - itself a container, so elements are added to it with `AddChild`. Created with `CreateWindow(WindowConfig)`; `UltraCanvasWindow` is the platform's subclass. | `onWindowClosing`, `onWindowClosed`, `onWindowResize`, `onWindowMove`, `onWindowFocus`, `onWindowBlur`, `onWindowMinimize`, `onWindowMaximize` … (+8 inherited) |
